title: KayKit adventurers: knight, barbarian, mage, rogue, hooded rogue
summary: Five rigged low-poly toon fantasy heroes (body about 1.7 m, 6-7k tris each) with 76 clips each (idle, walk, run, jump, melee, ranged, spellcast, block, dodge, hit, death, cheer, sit) and a helper script that animates them from a CharacterBody3D's velocity.
use_when: The prompt needs a player hero or friendly NPCs in a fantasy, medieval, dungeon, RPG or cute action game. Default hero set: Knight for sword-and-shield, Barbarian for axe, Mage for staff/spells, Rogue for daggers, Rogue_Hooded for crossbow.
how_to_use: Instance res://starter/char-kaykit-adventurers/knight.tscn (or barbarian/mage/rogue/rogue_hooded.tscn) as a child of your player CharacterBody3D at position (0,0,0); the body's capsule should be radius 0.35, height 1.8, centred at y=0.9. The root script character_anim.gd reads the parent velocity every physics frame, plays idle/walk/run/jump/fall and turns the model to face movement, so no animation code is needed. Call $Knight.play_action("attack") from your own code (also: hit, cheer, block, dodge, cast, shoot, slash, chop, stab, heavy, spin, punch, kick, throw, interact, pickup, sit); it returns the clip length and emits action_finished(name). Call die() for the death clip, revive() to stand up. Change weapons by setting show_props (for example ["2H_Sword"] on the knight; options are listed in optional_props). Set auto_from_parent=false and call set_move_speed(speed, on_floor) to drive it manually.

contents.what: Knight, 1.85 m to helmet top, 1H sword + round shield shown (also 2H_Sword, 1H_Sword_Offhand, Badge/Rectangle/Spike_Shield)
Barbarian, 1.75 m, bear-hood, 2H axe shown (also 1H_Axe, 1H_Axe_Offhand, Barbarian_Round_Shield, Mug)
Mage, 1.7 m body, hat tip about 2.1 m, purple wizard hat, 2H staff shown (also 1H_Wand, Spellbook, Spellbook_open); attack = Spellcast_Shoot
Rogue, 1.70 m, green cape, two knives shown (also 1H/2H_Crossbow, Throwable)
Hooded rogue, 1.75 m, 2H crossbow shown; attack = 2H_Ranged_Shoot
Plays clips by standard name (clips dictionary maps names to KayKit clip names), speed-synced locomotion, play_action/die/revive, weapon visibility
Original KayKit GLBs (41-bone rig, 76 clips each, 1 texture each)

scale: metres, Y-up, faces -Z, pivot at the feet; models scaled 0.78 inside the wrapper
